"''I want to make him caf.|Ventress mind-tricking Yepa into making a cup of caf in Saffia.|}} '''Saffia''' was a [[city]]{{BuildFalconCite|70|Guide to the Galaxy}} on the [[planet]] [[Serenno]], over one hundred [[kilometer]]s away from the [[capital]] city of [[Carannia]]. While smaller in size and influence, the city was a host to similar architectural designs to the capital, and also adopted the same anti-[[Galactic Republic|Republic]] stance in the last days of its rule. In [[23 BBY]],Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] states that she spent a year prior to outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] trying to defeat the Military Creation Act. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the outbreak of the Clone Wars as occurring in [[22 BBY]], the Military Creation Act must have been proposed by [[23 BBY]]. [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] [[mind trick]]ed [[Yepa]] into making a cup of [[Caf]] in Saffia for her [[Raz Fellidrone|boss]]. ==Behind the scenes== Fiyaro was a location that was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 70]] magazine published by [[De Agostini]] and released on [[May 4]], [[2016]].{{BuildFalconDates|70}} In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the location was first mentioned in the [[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]] novel.''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' ==Appearances== *''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' {{Mo}} *[[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|''Dooku: Jedi Lost'' script]] {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|70|Guide to the Galaxy}} {{1stm}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Saffia |ja=サフィア }} [[Category:Cities]] [[Category:Confederacy of Independent Systems cities]] [[Category:Serenno locations]]
